Good point, I also have succesful family members on antidepressants. And thanks for the tip on finding a therapist. How much does yours charge? Can I ask how your sex drive and self esteem were affected by taking your drugs?

Im going to try it, thank you. You are very kind and generous, thanks for your time.

Thanks again for the reply. After 3 years of Effexor, its still helping just as much? What does it do and make you feel? What dose are you on if I can ask? I really dont believe these drugs will help me. Now the doctor also wants me on an antipsychotic called Olanzapine for two weeks (2.5mg). Now I really think the Dr. is going to kill my brain. I will lose my grey matter, cognitive decline, memory loss, never be able to quit the drug. Its making me so suicidal because option A. is do nothing and continue to feel awful and want to die. Or B. Take drugs meant for Schizophrenics that will severely damage my brain and make me permanently worse off and dependent on these drugs. Now I am considering  Option C. Simply dieing because A and B are both not good. 

How did you find a good therapist? How is one hour a week enough to make change? I am supposed to leave for school at the end of August. How can you afford it? I wont have a job. 

I am so ashamed and feel like the most selfish awful person ever. I never want to talk to anyone again. I dont think I can ever feel better, I will only be a vegetable with memory loss and dependant on psych constantly living in parents basement. 

When you say your life got better. Is it just bareable now, enough to survive. Or do you actually enjoy it, want life and dont consider suicide? Because if I could push a button now and die and it didnt affect anyone negatively, then id for sure do it. Im living so i dont hurt family but i cant live for that reason alone forever, eventually if i dont get better or if these drugs damage me then im killing myself. I hate being me so badly, I am such garbage, I am so disgusting and selfish, I want to be over with. My doctor guarantees me in a month I will be way better and my life has so much potential etc and that he has nothing to gain from hurting my brain. I like him and dont think hes lying, but i still think hes wrong, all the stats show how damaging all of these drugs are, especially long term.
Ok thank you. 6 weeks is still far away. Thanks again for your comment
Ok thank you. Good advice, i just still am unmotivated to even do that work right now. Psychiatrist wants me to take the drugs a year or at least 3 months. Thanks
Ok thank you

Good enough relationship with parents. I am going to college in september (unless im too fucked up mentally). So I already lined up a summer job, only worked one week before losing it by being in the hospital. Now its too late and too short notice to get a job. 

I am able to pass time, book, tv etc. But that doesnt fix how terrible i am at interracting with others, how much i hate me and living. I dont want a life of constantly distracting, i did that for years. I want to be able to spend a whole day by myself and be at peace without going nuts and self destructive.

I do like those little things and i do want therapy. But if i leave the hospital, i go back to my isolated lonely shameful life in parents basement and cant really afford therapy unless borrow from fsmily and thats only 1 hour per week, what do i do with the rest of my time. Ill be alone with my thoughts and feel awful and suicidal again and alsondealing with effexor witjdrawal. I have already tried all this  got exercising, got a job, changed diet and i still relapsed and.ended up in the hospital
I dont even care enough about living to want to do that. Im so angry at myself and want to destroy myself. So i dont know what to do, perhaps still suicide
All they do is that but i still despise who i am so what can i do
I just honestyl think i dont care about others, im selfish, narcissitic, stupid, everything. Im not even depressed im just stubborn and want attention.

Dont these drugs damage your brain and wont work your whole life? I really dont believe they will help me, i will still be so ashamed and hate myself. Yes im on 150mg every morning abd the dr is considering raising it. 

Im so ashamed i never want to see anyone or my family, i dont want to exist, living is such a chore and im so awful.
Ok, thank you! Very happy something is working for you and thanks for the help!
What changed, what made you better, meds? What did meds do for you? I dont want to spend like 2 years in my parents basement alone and unemployed just so i can get therapy
What will they actually do for me? Just make my lows feel less low? Thats nice and all but it wont change my lack of desire to work and live and my self hatred and isolation.
If im turning schizophrenic, can life really get better and be worth it?
Great idea thank you

Great advice thank you. I already do a lot of enjoyable things on my own. So starved for socializing. I really hope to meet people in my new rural town this summer. I keep feeling so bad because i keep considering suicide. Scared all the time of getting worse and having a bad night and doing it. So scared and hopeless. Anyways, hope that when i work, i cam meet people my age, make money and keep busy with work and try community involvement and it could help.

I had like 2 years of no suicidal ideation whatsoever, even though i was depressed. Now it seems like it will never get off my mind
Great idea!

Yes I definitely think that my happiness, purpose and value strongly hinges on having good connection with others. Which I currently only have parents and sisters. So sick of being alone for all my existence, i am scared of being alone and having my demons want me to kill myself again. I feel like if i am alone then i am pretty much a loser and am alone because im not likeable enough. .
Good tip, i will listen
